About US

Advancing
Life Sciences Research

ClinGene (SMC-Private) Limited is a human genetics and precision medicine platform in Pakistan, bringing academic researchers, clinicians, and industrial partners together to advance research and contribute to the well-being of society.

We also work across other areas of biomedical sciences, focusing on training the next generation of researchers in state-of-the-art technologies, scientific discovery, critical thinking, independent research, and teamwork.
